plans.note: Cap is mutual at greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, with mutual consequential exclusion and Excluded Claims list (confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnities, gross negligence/wilful misconduct/fraud, IP infringement). Check 21.4 savings language. Likely compliant; do not double-flag indemnity or LD points here.

Vendor IP indemnity (20.1) plus misconduct/law/data/bodily-injury indemnity (20.2); Customer's indemnity in 20.3 is narrow with carve-outs. Procedure in 20.4 and infringement remedies in 20.5 (cross-referenced by 9.3). Confirm indemnities sit outside the cap via 21.3.

12.3 expressly preserves Customer's freedom to build, buy and compete and disclaims non-compete/MFC/no-hire commitments. Check whether the exclusivity language at 2.2 (first instance) functions as a de facto non-compete; if so treat under EXCLUSIVITY to avoid double-flagging.

sec-2.2 (the first of two clauses numbered 2.2) makes Vendor sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics for the term — a direct deviation. Note tension with 2.1 (no purchase commitment) and 12.3 (no exclusivity acknowledged); recommend deletion.

sec-7.2 (first clause numbered 7.2) obliges Customer to give Vendor terms no less favourable than its best terms to any other technology supplier — MFN running against us, a deviation. 12.3 disclaims MFC commitments; flag the conflict.

12.4 binds Customer for eighteen months post-termination, covers any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term, and bars engagement as well as solicitation, with no general-advertising carve-out — deviation; narrow to 12 months, personnel actually involved in the Services, with advertising/inbound carve-out.

Section 9 has cause-based, insolvency and Customer special termination rights (and 27.3 force-majeure exit) but no apparent termination for convenience by Customer on notice; note that Section 9.4 is absent from the outline, so confirm no convenience right exists before treating as missing.

8.2 auto-renews Order Forms for 12 months but requires 180 days' non-renewal notice — excessive window, likely deviation; 8.3 caps uplift at lesser of CPI and 3% with 90 days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods, which is favourable and should be acknowledged, not flagged.
New York law with CISG disclaimer and exclusive New York County courts, plus a pre-suit executive escalation that does not bar urgent relief. Accepted position; likely compliant.

24.1 allows Customer affiliate/successor assignment without consent; 24.2 restricts Vendor; 24.4 bars Vendor termination or repricing on our change of control; 13.3 permits licence transfer on permitted assignment. Likely compliant.

Customer owns Customer Data and Deliverables with present assignment and personnel assignments; Vendor Technology retained but licensed under 13.2. Check 14.2 'subject to payment' condition and 15.1 no-model-training restriction; likely compliant.

13.1 covers Affiliates and contractors worldwide; 13.2 grants perpetual irrevocable paid-up licence for delivered/embedded Vendor Technology; 13.3 limits revocation/suspension to material uncured breach after cure opportunity. Likely compliant.

sec-22.1 permits Vendor audits at any time without notice with remote system access — deviation (require annual frequency, 30 days' notice, business hours, off-site records review). 22.2/22.3 are protective (Vendor bears cost absent >5% shortfall, no direct system or unrelated data access) and support the fix.

sec-7.6 imposes USD 25,000/day liquidated damages on Customer for dependency delays — deviation; delete or convert to good-faith relief/equitable adjustment of timeline. No service-credit regime appears in the outline (service-level exhibit referenced in 2.2).

Services/professional warranty plus 90-day Deliverable conformity and term-long hosted conformity; 19.4 gives re-perform/repair/replace with termination and refund fallback and is non-exclusive for major claims; 19.5 disclaimer is mutual and preserves express remedies. Likely compliant.

Vendor carries CGL 1M/2M, workers' comp, employer's liability 1M, E&O 2M and cyber 5M for the term plus one year, with certificates on request and no limitation of liability. Likely compliant; note cancellation notice is only 'to the extent available'.

2.1 expressly disclaims minimum quantity or purchase commitment and confirms non-ordering is not a breach; 7.1 bars unstated minimum-use charges. Likely compliant; keep the LD point under LD, not here.
Six-month transition assistance at expiring Order Form rates, 30-day data return in machine-readable format with no fee-dispute hostage, and certified deletion. Likely compliant.
